The system is comprised of two aerated lagoons, a facultative pond, a chlorine contact pipe, and three percolation ponds.
Effluent from the facultative pond is directed to the chlorine contact chamber and slide gates control effluent flow rates to the percolation ponds.
Disposal in the ponds is accomplished by a combination of evaporation and percolation.
